t: Flomasta PipeGrip Elbow is a compact push-fit water pipe connector that makes turning 10mm pipework quick and easy. With a dual locking mechanism and green band for peace of mind, it delivers a tight, leak-free 90° bend. WRAS approved and compatible with copper or plastic pipe, these pipe elbows are perfect for tight, awkward spaces.
b: Suitable for Hard & Soft Water Areas
